$comment: PROVENANCE ONLY. This file records where each skill came from. Nothing reads
it at runtime, and no workflow syncs against it.
The skills in .claude/skills/ are the source of truth in this repository.
Two kinds live here, and the difference matters:
- PORTED skills were hand-copied from derekwinters/lucas-doggiehood and
then diverged to fit this game. A sync would revert local work, which is
exactly why the upstream project disabled its own sync.
- VENDORED skills are verbatim third-party copies, pinned to an upstream
commit. They have no local divergence yet, so re-vendoring them is a
clean diff — but it is still a manual, reviewed act, not a schedule.
sync_reason: Skills here are local and hand-maintained. A scheduled sync would overwrite local divergence with an upstream copy that does not know about this game, and would pull unreviewed third-party instructions into the agent's context on a timer.

upstream.role: historical source, not a live dependency

vendored_upstreams.role: vendored verbatim, not a live dependency
vendored_upstreams.selection: The 25 skills listed in the upstream .claude-plugin/plugin.json, flattened out of its skills/<category>/ tree. The misc/ and in-progress/ trees are deliberately excluded upstream from that plugin manifest, and are excluded here too.
vendored_upstreams.notes: Vendored rather than installed as a plugin because Claude Code plugins are per-user machine state, and this repo needs the skills to be present, reviewable, and pinned for anyone who clones it.

skills.name: release-flow
skills.notes: Rewritten around this repo's release-please config paths and the pull-request-title-pattern set in .github/release-please/config.json.

skills.name: run-tests
skills.notes: Commands resolved to this repo's Core suite and CI scripts; records the EditMode CI-only limitation as a non-deviation.

skills.name: ci-watch
skills.notes: Classifier written against this repo's check names and verified on PRs #130 and #123.

skills.name: scaffold-core
skills.notes: Namespaces, folder layout, and the no-meta-for-Tests/Core rule follow this repo's tech-stack.md.

skills.name: core-unity-split
skills.notes: Reference only; defers to docs/engineering/tech-stack.md rather than restating the rule, so the two cannot drift.

skills.name: issue-blockers
skills.notes: Adds an audit subcommand that finds prose blockers with no native relationship; keeps 'Depends on:' as soft ordering.

skills.name: milestone-ops
skills.notes: Adds the FROZEN marker check from this repo's conventions, and refuses to close a milestone with open issues.

skills.name: pipeline-gatekeeper
skills.notes: Vocabulary and refusal reason codes follow issues #53-#61; the bad-actor gate and idempotency are enforced inside the parser.

skills.name: code-review
skills.notes: Name collides with the built-in code-review skill in some harnesses. Kept verbatim so the /code-review references inside the other vendored skills still resolve.

skills.name: grilling
skills.notes: Derek also has a shorter personal skill of the same name; which one wins is harness precedence, not something this repo controls.

skills.name: resolving-merge-conflicts
skills.notes: Describes merge-conflict resolution generically. This repo rebases rather than merges (CLAUDE.md rule 7), so the rebase path is the one that applies.

skills.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
skills.notes: Generates the docs/agents/ files the other vendored skills look for. Not run yet — it writes repo docs and picks an issue tracker, which is Derek's call.

skills.name: tdd
skills.notes: General TDD reference. This repo's binding rule is still CLAUDE.md rule 1 and docs/engineering/testing.md.

skills.name: triage
skills.notes: Distinct from this repo's triage-issue skill, which is the one the nightly pipeline uses. Do not substitute one for the other.

skills.name: wizard
skills.notes: Good fit for the Direct Involvement Needed milestone — it generates a bash walkthrough for steps only Derek can do.
